SEARCH
Package edu.kit.datamanager.takita.model

Class Manuscript

java.lang.Object
edu.kit.datamanager.takita.model.Manuscript
public class Manuscript extends Object
The manuscript class represents the model of a manuscript with all ist attributes. It is used to create the SearchIndex.
